card: Backports PRs #36297 and #36230 to the 32.x release branch. It fixes invalid OpenRPC default metadata where argument fallback text was treated as literal default values or had mismatched types, and optimizes wallet descriptor lookups by caching and comparing SHA-256 hashes of canonical descriptor strings instead of repeatedly recomputing the strings. Both changes have already been merged to master.
evidence: Commit 7a0964a252 (#36297): 'The getdeploymentinfo blockhash fallback and four sighashtype fallbacks describe how omitted arguments are resolved. They are not literal values accepted by the RPCs, so mark them as DefaultHint values. The send include_watching option is boolean, but its string default makes the generated schema internally inconsistent.'

Commit 7fdb8584da (#36230): 'The canonical string comparison was slow because it would compute the canonical string for each comparison. This can be sped up by holding the canonical string in memory... hashed so that the comparison operates over the hash of the canonical string.'
problem: The 32.x branch lacks recent master fixes: OpenRPC schemas contain invalid or misleading default metadata (such as string defaults for boolean flags or non-literal fallback text), and HasWalletDescriptor suffers from performance overhead because it repeatedly recomputes canonical descriptor strings during comparisons.

risk.why: A defect in descriptor canonical hashing or equivalence checking could result in wallet descriptor lookup failures or descriptor loading issues on the 32.x release branch.

scope_notes: The diff from merge-base includes unrelated 32.x branch commits (version bumps, asmap data, man pages) due to base branch tracking discrepancies, but the PR itself consists solely of the 9 commits backporting #36297 and #36230.
summary: Backports two merged master changes to the 32.x branch: RPC argument metadata fixes for OpenRPC defaults (#36297) and wallet descriptor lookup optimizations (#36230). Descriptor equivalence checks in the wallet now compare a cached SHA-256 hash of the canonical descriptor string rather than recomputing canonical strings on every check, and OpenRPC argument defaults that describe fallback logic are switched to DefaultHint.
